name: Square Covered Box with Hundred Antiquities (lid)
material: porcelain with famille rose overglaze enamel decoration
summary: The painted decoration in this box cover provides an interesting image of the antiquities and objects being collected in the Chinese scholar’s desk—all of which are emblems of taste, status, and affluence. Connoisseurship, art cataloguing, art historical study, and elegant social gatherings develope
